title: When the Protocol Burns Anew
author: E. M. Blackwood
blurb: Petra Fairweather, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
